description: Maps keyboard bindings to inline input-guide icons and supplies French and German overrides at three sizes.

InputKey.simple: Keyboard key matched by the row.
InputKey.technical: For the requested game-key tag the decorator checks the first bound key for player 0, then player 1 if needed. It scans the CustomImageSet row map and picks the first row whose FKey InputKey equals that bound key.

Brush.technical: Used for size Normal. For French and German layouts the corresponding localized brush replaces this one when HasUObject() succeeds.

SmallBrush.technical: Used for size Small. For French and German layouts the corresponding localized brush replaces this one when HasUObject() succeeds.

TinyBrush.technical: Used for size Tiny. For French and German layouts the corresponding localized brush replaces this one when HasUObject() succeeds.

Brush_French.simple: Normal icon for the French keyboard layout.
Brush_French.technical: Selected for keyboard language French and size Normal. The decorator calls HasUObject() on this brush and falls back to the default brush of the same size when it has no resource.

SmallBrush_French.simple: Small icon for the French keyboard layout.
SmallBrush_French.technical: Selected for keyboard language French and size Small. The decorator calls HasUObject() on this brush and falls back to the default brush of the same size when it has no resource.

TinyBrush_French.simple: Tiny icon for the French keyboard layout.
TinyBrush_French.technical: Selected for keyboard language French and size Tiny. The decorator calls HasUObject() on this brush and falls back to the default brush of the same size when it has no resource.

Brush_German.simple: Normal icon for the German keyboard layout.
Brush_German.technical: Selected for keyboard language German and size Normal. The decorator calls HasUObject() on this brush and falls back to the default brush of the same size when it has no resource.

SmallBrush_German.simple: Small icon for the German keyboard layout.
SmallBrush_German.technical: Selected for keyboard language German and size Small. The decorator calls HasUObject() on this brush and falls back to the default brush of the same size when it has no resource.

TinyBrush_German.simple: Tiny icon for the German keyboard layout.
TinyBrush_German.technical: Selected for keyboard language German and size Tiny. The decorator calls HasUObject() on this brush and falls back to the default brush of the same size when it has no resource.

usages.detail: Exposes the keyboard decorator's CustomImageSet UDataTable property.
Reads the first binding for each player, scans the row map, and picks an icon based on the keyboard language and requested size.

notes: The keyboard scan reads the row map directly. Assign a table with FGameWidgetInputGuideKeyboardImageRow as the row struct.
The available exports supply no keyboard icon records.
